methodology: Public repository snapshot; one editorial category per project. Excludes the .github profile repository from the chart. Counts are not downloads, maturity, test coverage or hardware acceptance.

projects.name: ha-desloc
projects.scope_note: Unofficial cloud integration; C100 Plus maintainer-tested; model features vary.

projects.name: ha-desloc-card
projects.scope_note: One adaptive action button and explicit unlock confirmation; historical overview GIF still depicts older two-button UI.

projects.name: ha-echo-dot
projects.scope_note: Echo Dot 2 / EchoLocal; wake-word training and exact-runtime evaluation; hardware-specific conversion.

projects.name: ha-echo-show-5
projects.scope_note: Echo Show 5 Gen2; conversion depends on exact hardware and verified recovery backups.

projects.name: slzb-06-recovery
projects.scope_note: Original SLZB-06 legacy Ethernet recovery; core and Zigbee-radio firmware are separate.

projects.name: rf-airbridge
projects.scope_note: ESP8266 + CC1101, ESPHome 2026.8.2, 433.92 MHz ASK/OOK; not arbitrary RF or rolling-code support.

projects.name: zigbee-direct-button
projects.scope_note: Hardware-specific direct group firmware; see model qualification and OTA wake requirements.

projects.name: ha-tuya-esphome
projects.scope_note: Legacy ESP8266 plug variants; GPIO and conversion results vary by unit; encrypted USB profile now recommended.

projects.name: home-studio
projects.scope_note: Browser editor with local draft/JSON exports, compiler and HA viewer; hosted editor itself does not connect to HA.

projects.name: home-assistant
projects.scope_note: Public configuration plus bundled automation/script libraries; installation-specific values are private inputs.

projects.name: k3s-self-healing
projects.scope_note: Approval-gated updates, backups and recovery; single-replica local storage is not automatic node/storage failover.

projects.name: ha-lg-tv-capture
projects.scope_note: On-demand snapshot camera; depends on undocumented webOS interfaces and firmware/app support; protected content can be black.

projects.name: ha-echomuse
projects.scope_note: Echo Dot 2 / RS03QR; current recorded speech pipeline uses cloud STT and is not fully offline.

projects.name: zac93-esp32
projects.scope_note: Hardware ordered; physical commissioning pending. Supplied diagrams/configuration checks are not radio acceptance.

projects.name: sensing-evidence-kit
projects.scope_note: Characterizes disagreements/unknown time; validation_decision remains not_evaluated.

projects.name: ruview-home-assistant
projects.scope_note: Experimental collector observations with freshness/placement gates; not validated occupancy detection.

projects.name: ha-access-session
projects.scope_note: One explicitly mapped HA administrator with full privileges; not multi-user or entity-scoped authorization.

projects.name: ha-onvif-room-direction
projects.scope_note: Read-only camera direction estimate; no person identification or occupancy claim; calibration required.

projects.name: assist-scenario-lab
projects.scope_note: Offline protocol/action/audible-response evidence; examples synthetic and hardware acceptance separate.

projects.name: ha-entity-migrations
projects.scope_note: Offline semantic migration plans with role and hardware ownership; does not apply changes.

projects.name: ha-meter-contracts
projects.scope_note: Offline meter topology/provenance/calibration-evidence validation; not physical calibration.

projects.name: ha-scenario-tests
projects.scope_note: Bounded synthetic scenarios in a real isolated HA engine; not live hardware commissioning.
